footprint.notes: U.S. plants by state: GM's U.S. Operations page (gm.com/company/us-operations, re-read 2026-11-24 and unchanged) lists its facilities state by state (59 entries; the page says "50 assembly and parts facilities across 19 states" and "97k+ GM employees in the U.S."), but it publishes no count, employment or investment figure per state, so usStates is null rather than a tally made here; 12 of the listed facilities are recorded as sites. The page lists the Hudson's Detroit headquarters as opened in 2026, and the FY2025 10-K cover address is 1240 Woodward Avenue, Detroit. The FY2025 10-K Item 2 gives only national totals ("over 100 locations in the U.S." and operations "in 33 countries"; major non-U.S. facilities in Canada and Mexico (GMNA) and Brazil, China and South Korea (GMI)). Employees come from the FY2025 10-K table, filed in thousands: GMNA 119, GMI 28, GM Financial 9 (not shown), total 155; U.S. salaried 47 and hourly 47 are separate metrics, not added. The FY2024 table's note that GMNA includes Cruise is gone. GMNA and GMI are GM segments with no country list in the 10-K.
